result: Personen/onderwerpen en eigen herinneringen zijn in één geïnstalleerde privébediening te zoeken, met exact bronbewijs, aparte labels voor bron/afleiding/legacy, huidige mensbegripherzieningen en bestaande correctie-/vergeetroutes.

steps: Zoek een naam of onderwerp; kies Bron bekijken en aanpassen.
Kies Informatie corrigeren of Deze bron vergeten. De bevestiging zegt wat behouden blijft.
userAccess.access: Existing local owner gateway; no manually entered dashboard token

reused: Current owner binding/private audience and PostgreSQL outbox source readers
Hindsight current scoped recall (UI-only bounded entity names)
Existing journal + HumanUnderstandingActions linked revision + coldpath retention
Existing exact document/exchange erasure and paginated own source list

validation.testDatabase: Separately named disposable database on existing PostgreSQL18.6; no production memory mutation

installation.secondDispatchReason: One independent review finding: private semantic content must clear on tab hiding and revalidate authority on return. Final assets-only fix; no rollback or discarded backend work.

usage.note: Existing memory search/embedding backend was used for actual read verification; this usage was not separately metered. No paid conversation/benchmark was started.

preparationFailures: Focused test runner initially used wrong DSN environment variable; corrected before disposable database tests.
Synthetic unmount assertion initially ran before navigation had rendered; waited for the destination heading.
Independent review caught typed submission-method mismatch, document-erasure copy scope and hidden-tab privacy clearing; all corrected and specifically checked.
limitations: Names can be persons or topics from own admissible memories. Ranked selection plus name/topic search is not an exhaustive person directory or access to another family member’s private account.
Correct/forget proven against actual existing PostgreSQL routes in an isolated disposable database; installed household data was read only, never mutated for demonstration.
Typed correction remains a provisional inference and is queued until retention finishes. Pending or stale revision heads are not silently corrected.
Document erasure preserves original ingress/work artifacts; exchange erasure retains its existing broader exchange semantics. Other independently sourced memories may remain.
This completes E2.2 controls only; E2.3–E2.6, daily household acceptance and whole-project delivery stay separate.
